scope: Mandasaru live delivery and evidence-only receipt candidate before final review integration and commit

independent_release_checks.method: Read-only GitHub PR/run responses and actual release logs.

independent_live_checks.variant_scope: Three Mandasaru variants plus three Daringbadi reading-path variants. Every live filename SHA-256 prefix verified. Mandasaru dimensions match descriptors and 3:2 geometry.
independent_live_checks.incoming_preview_checks: All three incoming cards contain the actual article link, illustration and visible Illustration label. Their credit sections have no empty anchors and retain existing photograph credits/licence links.
independent_live_checks.method: Fresh HTTPS reads, in-memory image decoding/hashing and HTML parsing.

screenshot_review.independent_action: Drishti visually inspected all five saved live screenshots.
screenshot_review.observed: Readable desktop/mobile title, Founder byline, full-frame interpretive illustration and explicit qualification; five-note list with returns; labelled Hills and Explore cards. No visible clipping issue in reviewed views.
screenshot_review.interaction_attribution: Keyboard note/return, focus, filter behavior, exact dimensions and overflow are Disha browser observations, not interactions independently repeated by Drishti.
screenshot_review.keyboard_limit: Disha records note top -0.21875px, return reference visible at 412.3984375px with correct focus. No claim that the return reference was at viewport top.

resolved_evidence_issue.resolution: Original false retained with a case-sensitive diagnostic limitation; visible_illustration_label true is separately supported by actual HTML and independently viewed screenshot. Saved and canonical browser records match.

receipt_review.scope_release: Only after the separately reviewed receipt merges; Mahendragiri remains queued.
receipt_review.brass_exclusion: Prior independent full/coastal/final marker, path and original-byte scans passed; website source remains unchanged from the reviewed publication merge.
receipt_review.subsequent_user_confirmation: Canonical receipt and internal media provenance consistently record the coordinator-reported user quote “Use a clearly captioned illustration”, received after publication during receipt review. Timing is explicit and original default-under-standing-authorization history is preserved; no retroactive approval claim.
receipt_review.reason_no_deployment: Internal records, provenance annotation and captured evidence only.

remaining_gate: Coordinator may integrate this accurately attributed review and actual review event, regenerate views, commit the evidence-only receipt, pass required exact-head checks and merge before starting another article.
limits: Separate AI review, not human specialist approval or field verification.
The artwork is an interpretive illustration, not a documentary photograph or verified viewpoint.
Screenshots do not certify physical-device, screen-reader or cross-engine behavior.
Receipt commit, required checks and merge remain pending at this review point.
Brass-draft exclusion is scoped marker/original-byte checking, not perceptual detection of every possible transformed image.
